senses.gloss:
गि(गे)ष्णुः [गै-इष्णुच् आद्गुणः]
1 A
singer.
--2 Especially, a Brāhmaṇa
versed in the hymns of the
Sāmaveda and who chants them.
गेष्णुः [गै इष्णुच्] A singer, an actor.

गेष् {c1c} A. (गेषते, गेष्ण) To seek,
search, investigate; cf. गवेष्.

1 A singer, a professional
singer.
--2 An actor.
